name: incident_response
description: GhostBuster Incident Response — When a Sentry/Datadog alert fires, automatically trace root cause via CausalTrace, assess PII risk via Laya AI, and generate a compile-safe fix.

steps.name: Fetch stack trace
steps.description: Pull the full stack trace and error metadata from Sentry/Datadog.

steps.name: PII safety check (Laya)
steps.description: Laya noul checks whether the implicated snapshot fields contain PII before including them in the fix context.

steps.name: Generate compile-safe fix (Claude)
steps.description: Claude synthesises a fix from the causal narrative. Fix is validated at the AST level.

steps.name: Open fix PR
steps.description: Open a PR with the generated fix, causal narrative, and test regression.
